changelog:
Send what you are watching to your TV from the player, and the phone pauses once the TV starts.

WHAT CHANGED

- While a TV is paired, the player has a TV button. It sends what is playing to the TV, the same as the long-press menu does.
- A film or episode sent from the player carries where you are in it. Your TV starts it there once its own PerchTV update arrives; until then it starts from the beginning.
- When the TV starts playing what you sent, from the player or from a list, the phone pauses its own copy, so you do not hear it twice. If the TV cannot play it, the phone keeps playing. Press play on the phone to pick it up again.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.7: closing the picture-in-picture window returns to the list, not a black screen.
